name: Andel
source:
A mysterious girl who appears before Mitsuyoshi and Michiru.
Like a transparent illusion her appearance is.
In the memory of where everything in Koga's residence was burning, this girl was somehow there...
Is it an illusion of unpleasant memories? Merely a nightmare?
Or...
